summary: Iter38c — Caisse Dépenses + Matricule auto + Dashboard card backend testing. All 11 dedicated tests pass and full iter38 regression (45/45) green. Validated CRUD permissions (admin-only edit/delete, can_cash creates), justification within/after deadline (force=true admin only), deadline=0 unlimited rule, monthly summary tenant isolation, dashboard card filtered by current user, payslip late_expenses_deduction (>=7500 on 100h-old expense), auto-matricule MAT-{TENANT}-{seq:05d} per-tenant counter, and backfill endpoint. Router /api/cashier/expenses correctly mounted in server.py and reachable (401 without auth).
critical_code_review_comments: File size warning: /app/backend/routes/hr.py is 1231 lines (>700 threshold). Consider splitting into hr_employees.py, hr_payslip.py, hr_absences.py, hr_settings.py for maintainability.
JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is 28 bytes — emits InsecureKeyLengthWarning (RFC 7518 recommends >=32 bytes). Non-blocking but should be rotated to a 32+ byte secret.
cashier_expenses.py (396 lines) is well-scoped; permissions checked consistently (can_cash/admin/sup) and tenant isolation via parent_client_id resolution is correct.
Test fixture leaves db.settings deadline at 72h after teardown (no cleanup) — acceptable since 72h is the documented default, but worth a note.
